import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; c=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); c.append((y,x,v))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and g[p[0]][p[1]]!=bg and not seen[p[0]][p[1]]:
                            seen[p[0]][p[1]]=True; st.append(p)
                out.append(c)
    return out
for d in [1,2,3,4]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps(I,bg)
    cnt=Counter((v,len(c)) for c in C)
    big=max(C,key=len)
    fill=Counter(v for _,_,v in big).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rare=min(Counter(v for _,_,v in big),key=lambda c:(Counter(v for _,_,v in big)[c],c))
    print('=== d',d,'fill',fill,'rare',rare,'template at',(big[0]))
    # template shape relative to its top-left
    ty0,tj0,_=min(big)
    rel=sorted(set(((y-ty0,x-tj0,v) for y,x,v in big)))
    print('   rel cells:',rel)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; c=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); c.append((y,x,v))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and g[p[0]][p[1]]!=bg and not seen[p[0]][p[1]]:
                            seen[p[0]][p[1]]=True; st.append(p)
                out.append(c)
    return out
# For each demo: identify "stamp regions" in output = connected components of O not present in I
for d in range(1,7):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps(I,bg); big=max(C,key=len)
    cnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in big); fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # template colors: fill and possible minority color(s)
    minority=sorted(set(cnt)-{fill}, key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    marks=[c[0] for c in C if len(c)==1 and c[0][2]!=fill]
    mc=set(m[2] for m in marks)
    print('=== d',d,'fill',fill,'minority',minority,'markercolors',sorted(mc),'nmarks',len(marks))
    # find template absolute anchor & shape
    ys=[y for y,x,_ in big]; xs=[x for y,x,_ in big]
    y0,x0=min(ys),min(xs)
    ts=[(y-y0,x-x0,v) for y,x,v in big]
    print('   tl',(y0,x0),'rel sample:',ts[:4],'n',len(ts))

# Verify d6 hypothesis computationally: stamp template (minority color at its own position, other cells fill) anchored so rarest cell lands on marker.
def f(g):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps(g,bg); big=max(C,key=len)
    cnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in big); fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ys=[y for y,x,_ in big]; xs=[x for y,x,_ in big]
    y0,x0=min(ys),min(xs)
    ts=[(y-y0,x-x0,v) for y,x,v in big]
    rcnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in ts)
    rare=min(rCENT, key=rCENT.get)  # minority color of template
    rares=[(y,x) for y,x,v in ts if v==rare]
    marks=[c[0] for c in C if len(c)==1 and c[2]!=fill]
    o=[row[:] for row in g]
    for cy,cx,cv in marks:
        ty,tx=rares[0]
        sy,sx=cy-ty,cx-tx
        for ry,rx,vv in ts:
            ny,nx=sy+ry,sx+rx
            if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx)!=(cy,cx):
                o[ny][nx]=fill if v!=rare else rare  # rare cells keep their color? test both variants
    return o
for d in [6]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    ok = f(I)==O
    print(d,'hypothesis match',ok)

G=load()
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; c=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); c.append((y,x,v))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and g[p[0]][p[1]]!=bg and not seen[p[0]][p[1]]:
                            seen[p[0]][p[1]]=True; st.append(p)
                out.append(c)
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; c=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); c.append((y,x,v))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                            seen[p[0]][p[1]]=True; st.append(p)
                out.append(c)
    return out

def analyze(d):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps(I,bg); big=max(Cs,key=len)
    ys=[y for y,x,_ in big]; xs=[x for y,x,_ in big]
    y0,x0=min(ys),min(xs)
    ts=[(y-y0,x-x0,I[y][x]) for y,x,v in big]
    cnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in ts); rarec=next(v for v,n in cnt.items() if n==1)
    singles=[c[0] for c in Cs if len(c)==1]
    chgs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]==bg and O[i][j]!=bg: chgs.append((i,j,O[i][j]))
    added=[c for c in chgs if c[0] not in [(y,y0+x0) for y,x,_ in ts]]
    print(f'--- d{d}: bg={bg}, rarec={rarec}, nchgs={len(chgs)}, nadded={len(added)}')
    # match each added cell to nearest singleton
    uniq={}
    for (i,j,c_) in added:
        best=None

            sy,sx=s[0],s[1]; dy,dx=i-sy,j-sx

            key=((dy,dx),c_)

            # find nearest mark of same base class

for d in [5,6,7]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps(I,bg); big=max(Cs,key=len)
    ys=[y for y,x,_ in big]; xs=[x for y,x,_ in big]
    y0,x0=min(ys),min(xs)
    ts=[(y-y0,x-x0,I[y][x]) for y,x,v in big]
    cnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in ts); rarec=next(v for v,n in cnt.items() if n==1)
    # rare abs pos
    ra=[(yy,y0+xx) for yy,xx,v in ts if v==rarec][0]
    stray=[c for c in comps(I,bg) if len(c)==1 and c[2]!=rarec and c[2]!=2][0] if False else None
    singles=[c[0] for c in Cs if len(c)==1]
    others=[s for s in singles if s[2]==2]
    print(f'=== d{d}: rare color {rarec}, rare abs {ra}, stray single color {[s[2] for s in singles if s[2]!=rarec and s[2]!=2]}, marks {others}')

Cs=comps(I,1);big=max(Cs,key=len)
ys=[y for y,x,_ in big];xs=[x for y,x,_ in big]
y0,x0=min(ys),min(xs)
ts=[(y-y0,x-x0,I[y][x]) for y,x,v in big]
cnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in ts);rarec=next(v for v,n in cnt.items() if n==1)

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter
def comps_nonbg(I,bg):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if I[y][x]!=bg and (y,x) not in seen:
                st=[(y,x)]; seen.add((y,x)); c=[]
                while st:
                    p=st.pop(); c.append(p)
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=p[0]+dy,p[1]+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and I[ny][nx]!=bg and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(c)
    return out
Tf=[[[] for _ in range(1)] ] # placeholder
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_nonbg(I,bg)
    big=max(cs,key=len)
    # rare color in big comp
    cnt=Counter(I[p[0]][p[1]] for p in big)
    rare=min(cnt,key=lambda c:(cnt[c],c))
    rp=[p for p in big if I[p[0]][p[1]]==rare][0]
    ys=[p[0] for p,v in big];xs=[p[1] for p,v in big]
    y0,x0=min(ys),min(xs); h_=max(ys)-y0+1; w_=max(xs)-x0+1
    T=[[I[y0+a][x0+b] for b in range(w_)] for a in range(h_)]
    T=T+[[I[min(y0,h_-1)]*[W] for _ in range(1)]]*0
    oy=rp[0]-y0; ox=rp[1]-x0
    O=[row[:] for row in I]

        ty,tz=pos[0]-oy,pos[1]-ox
        for a in range(h_):
            for b in range(w_):
                ny,nx=ty+a,tz+b
                if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W: O[ny][nx]=T[a][b]
